Narmi jiska na sah sake, taqat sah leti.
Grit ek kabhi na rukne wala dil.
Courage aur perseverance ka magical talisman—jis ke aage mushkile gayab.
Khamoshi woh sleep hai jo thought ko nourish karti.
Himmat jeet hai.
Grit raste par tike rehna hai.
Necessary ho to alone khade rehna courage.
Khamoshi ka aksar galat matlab nikala jata hai.
Khamoshi ek real friend hai jo kabhi betrayal nahi karti.
Chup rehna aisa dost hai jo kabhi dhokha nahi deta.
Dabaav ke beech shaant aur sthir rehna hi asli himmat hai.
Chalo raat me kadam rakhein aur jo humein pasand hai uska peecha karein.
Himmat azaadi ki seedhi hai.
Jo peechhe, jo aage—sab matter karta.
Sher ki dahad tez hoti hai, lekin uska chup rehna daravna hota hai.
Grit rakho, anmol bano.
Gir kar uthna hi grit hai.
